root_cause_hypothesis: Three defects, none of which any repo test could see, because each produces well-formed XML that only fails inside xppc — and then fails on the WRONG object. (1) d365fo_file(create, table) silently dropped properties.fieldGroups: the <FieldGroups> block in buildAxTableXml was a hardcoded literal holding only the five Auto* groups. Surfaced one step later as "Metadata Error: AxForm/.../Grid/DataGroup: Field group 'Overview' does not exist" — on the form, not the table that lost it. (2) d365fo_file(create, form) never resolved field control types, so every grid column came out AxFormStringControl; the date column failed with "AxForm/.../Grid_ConDueDate/DataField: Data type mismatch". The templates have accepted a fieldTypes map all along and generate_object supplies one — only this builder did not. (3) The form-event-handlers knowledge entry said to call _e.CancelSuperCall(). xppc: "Class 'FormControlEventArgs' does not contain a definition for 'CancelSuperCall'". The args must first be narrowed to FormControlCancelableSuperEventArgs.
